host_child.note: own deterministic short program; no busy loop, no data files; not an Agent

scope_summary_partial.avg_cores_note: avg cores = cpu/wall; NOT an efficiency metric
scope_summary_partial.memory_note: current/kernel-peak/sampled-max are distinct; scope peaks are never summed into a run peak

io.reason: degraded_host_v1_blkio: writeback attributed to root cgroup; reads are page-cache hits; not application bytes

diagnostic.reason: degraded_host_v1_blkio: writeback attributed to root cgroup; reads are page-cache hits; not application bytes

cumulative_end.note: cumulative counter value at final boundary (reference only; NOT the interval amount)

host_runner_process.cpu_basis: utime+stime tick delta between first/last READABLE snapshots (interval, not lifetime)
host_runner_process.rss_note: current/sampled-max distinct; kernel peak not read at process level; RSS never summed across processes
host_runner_process.final_value_note: a process_exited final read means the verified final is null; the last readable value is diagnostic only

collector.note: collector read cost measured separately from any workload metric; runner-process CPU/RSS is host_runner_process (includes collector), never double-counted as exclusive

coverage_gaps: descendants (docker exec clients) not individually tracked; short-lived grandchildren may be missed
kernel-peak (VmHWM) not recorded at host scope this batch
